z is adjacent only to R, which all have color 2, while z has color 3.

consequence: Every canonical state produced by any subset F is extendable.
Every prefix forcing history on F is nonterminal SAT.
Therefore every subset F is genuinely reachable by repeated authorized B2B1 forcing, not merely locally palette-admissible.
The 2^(k-1) profile family satisfies the D prereg reachability contract.
